caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or woven design displayed on a plain, off-white background. The textile features a symmetrical pattern mainly composed of green and reddish-brown colors against a beige base. In the upper central area, there is a large, intricate floral motif in green, enclosed by curved reddish-brown sections decorated with geometric shapes. The borders of the textile include smaller floral and foliate patterns, with plants, leaves, and scrolling stems in both colors. Along the left side, the words "HADDELEY DOUCH CORANS" and the date "1666" are woven in reddish-brown thread, accompanied by additional floral motifs and a tree. The lower section of the textile shows a detailed, symmetrical architectural scene in reddish-brown and green, including a central building flanked by two smaller towers, with trees on either side. The entire design has a grid-like composition structured around the central floral motif, architectural elements, and decorated borders.
title: Handwoven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
